split.method: Image groups stratified by (present, absent) pair counts; near-half quotas chosen for exact 250/250 balance, then closest image half and quota balance; lexicographic tie break; shuffle sorted image IDs within strata with random.Random(17).

selection.rule: maximum select exact; ties use A then B/C enumeration order, ascending thresholds and k/score

bootstrap.method: paired image cluster percentile bootstrap, numpy default_rng, linear quantiles; lower MAE is better
